integrity: Proof is self-contained, supporting verifier is reproducible, and the analysis has not received independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The all-general-position-set counting polynomial is covered by general join results and is not asserted new. A 2026 article specifically on maximal general-position-set counts was identified, but its full text could not be inspected; publication priority is provisional. Finite executable tests corroborate but do not replace the proof.
title: Exact facet spectrum and cyclic transfer polynomial for wheel general-position sets
